description: Configure automatic keyword comment hiding. Set keyword moderation for one owned Instagram or TikTok account. No DMs or credit charge. GET first, then pass settings.version for optimistic concurrency; a stale version returns moderation_version_conflict. Enabling requires a verified connection, comment access and usable Coverage. Disabling is always allowed for the owner. New signed comment events after saving are matched case-insensitively using Unicode NFKC; exceptions take priority, own comments are skipped. Whole-word mode treats letters, numbers and underscore as word characters. Hiding runs asynchronously after publication, normally immediately, with a five-minute recovery worker; comments can be visible before hiding. It cannot guarantee pre-publication filtering or delivery of every upstream webhook. Prior comments are not scanned. Rule changes cancel waiting older jobs. Provider quotas and shared per-account leases apply; Safe read verification can wait 330 seconds for newly received comments to become available. Processing is capped at three attempts; an external write is retried only after an explicit 429 refusal. Unknown writes are never resent automatically. Turning rules off does not restore hidden comments; TikTok unhide is currently unreliable. Dry-run validates without saving or hiding.

dry_run.description: Simulate this call: full validation and the real price, but nothing is created, no credits are debited, and no Idempotency-Key is consumed. Returned identifiers are synthetic and only usable in other dry-run calls.

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key header for safe retries.
